title: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tunes diffusion models with black-box rewards, but reverse-process methods such as Flow-GRPO are limited in efficiency by poor credit assignment, while forward-process methods such as DiffusionNFT are efficient yet unstable without carefully tuned exponential-moving-average (EMA) off-policy training. We show that NFT-style objectives contain a hidden forward--reverse consistency force that joint positive--negative training cancels only partially, and that EMA stabilizes training through restoration rather than off-policy rollouts. We introduce DiffusionART (Diffusion Reinforcement with Aggregation-First Reward Tilting), which aggregates each prompt's rewards into a shared reward-improving direction for reverse-process states, removing the consistency force by construction, and adds a trust-region-masked second update for drift-adaptive restoration without EMA tuning. It requires no differentiable r

translated_title: DiffusionART：高效、稳定且可扩展的扩散模型强化方法
translated_abstract: 在线强化学习（RL）利用黑盒奖励对扩散模型进行微调，但诸如 Flow-GRPO 这类反向过程方法的效率受限于糟糕的信用分配，而诸如 DiffusionNFT 这类前向过程方法虽然高效，但在缺乏精心调整的指数移动平均（EMA）离线策略训练时并不稳定。我们证明了 NFT 风格的目标函数中包含一种隐藏的前向-反向一致性力，联合的正负样本训练只能部分抵消这种力，并且 EMA 是通过恢复机制而非离线策略采样来稳定训练的。我们提出了 DiffusionART（基于聚合优先奖励倾斜的扩散模型强化），该方法将每个提示词的奖励聚合为一个共享的奖励提升方向并作用于反向过程状态，从而在构造上消除一致性力，同时增加一个由信任域掩码控制的第二次更新，实现无需 EMA 调参的漂移自适应恢复。该方法不需要可微分奖励……
tldr: DiffusionART 通过将每个提示词的奖励聚合为共享的奖励提升方向以在构造上消除前向-反向一致性力，并结合信任域掩码的二次更新实现无需 EMA 调参的漂移自适应恢复，从而实现扩散模型在线强化学习的高效、稳定与可扩展。
